about: Monthly costs outside AWS, entered by hand: subscriptions and seats that no API reports. This committed file is the example and carries no amounts. The priced copy lives beside it as fixed-costs.local.json, git-ignored; compose mounts it when AWS_FIXED_COSTS in .env points at it, and the exporter reads whatever FIXED_COSTS_FILE names. An item with amount_usd null is known but not priced; the exporter counts it as unpriced and leaves it off the bill. Amounts are what the invoice says, in USD; an invoice in another currency is converted by hand and the rate noted in 'about'. Every cost_center must be one of allocation.json's cost_centers.

items.about: Covers the Claude Code API calls. Once priced, the bill counts this amount for them and the dashboard shows their list price beside it; until then the bill counts the list price.
Organisation seats and Actions minutes beyond the free tier, if any.
